senses.definition: (nautical, obsolete, of a ship) Brought to lie as near to the windward as it can to get out to sea, and thereby held steady.

quotes.text: Lay her a hold, a hold, ſet her two courſes off to Sea againe, lay her off.

quotes.text: Uh-oh... I guess I shouldn't have given my last babysitter such a hard time. Somehow she got ahold of the video Mom took of me running around without my diaper ... and posted it on YouTube.
